operations.content: Graft/TrailCode: pin @nanonets/graft@0.15.0; 0.25.x serves deferred tools Hermes cannot read. Server resolves repo from cwd, so run it via wrapper script that cds into the indexed repo first.

Git on this Windows host: set repo-local credential.helper to empty to stop CredentialHelperSelector GUI popups; use git rm -r --cached -f when a locked file aborts unstage; secrets (.env, tokens, mcp-tokens, pairing, state) never enter repos.

n8n nodes: SplitInBatches outputs are [done, loop] (not loop-first); Code node defaults to runOnceForAllItems so per-item JS needs explicit mode; Switch v3.4 uses rules.values with renameOutput; Wait uses resume=timeInterval.

Hermes mcp_servers entries used here: tavily via shared rotator launcher (20 keys, TAVILY_DEFAULT_DEPTH=advanced); trailcode/neocoder via .cmd wrappers; n8n remote https://neodevstudio-n8n.hf.space/mcp-server/http on OAuth with tokens in mcp-tokens/n8n.json.
